deviations.what: c5 S10.3: the card leads with a red ↗ arrow and 'Money out ₹2,400' as its headline, then 'Cash in hand → Diesel' (the → drawn in a non-design face) and 'Diesel' again as the note; the frame leads with the narration 'Diesel' as the title, 'Written by Ramesh · dated 28 Aug' muted, and puts the amount '− ₹2,400' in red at the right of an amber 'Reached us 2 Sep, after August closed' line
deviations.reason: [screen] card hierarchy (amount-led vs narration-led). The arrow is a [shared] glyph-coverage defect: inbox.late.card.route is '{from} → {to}' and none of the bundled faces (Mukta, Mukta Mahee, Noto Sans — checked with fontTools) maps U+2192, so on a phone the platform's fallback face draws it, not a design face; only the test harness draws it as a box (design_capture.dart:76-78). The capture's face check passes because the run's family is Mukta. Same for '✓' in close.year.sealed.badge (S10.4). Author name is not shown
deviations.authority: 07 §1 rule 3 🔒 (sign or direction word with a tinted amount — both present); 11 §4.4 (Mukta faces); ADR 2026-10-05 §1
